REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - NOVEMBER 7, 2018 - CITY HALL -
7:00
P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS:
Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the Community Development Department, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m.
to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1201. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Cerritos Planning Commission after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Community Development Department at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time
each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the meeting will not
exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless
determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate
responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the
agenda, unless otherwise directed. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially
the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, public hearing is opened, and
report of written correspondence and staff report are received. Verbal testimony will occur
in the following order: those in favor of the application/item, those opposed, interested
parties, rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested to state their name and city of
residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the
matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the public
hearing.

Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2001-4(2018) RENEWAL, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT SYNERGY DEVELOPMENT SERVICES, INC., ON BEHALF OF T-MOBILE WEST CORPORATION, TO RENEW AN EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON A SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON TRANSMISSION TOWER. THE EXISTING WIRELESS FACILITY CONTAINS SIX (6) PANEL ANTENNAS, THREE (3) REMOTE RADIO UNITS, AND THREE (3) TOWER-MOUNTED AMPLIFIERS, AND LOCATED BENEATH THE SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON TRANSMISSION TOWER IS AN EXISTING EQUIPMENT ENCLOSURE THAT CONTAINS FOUR (4) SUPPORT EQUIPMENT CABINETS AND ONE (1) GLOBAL POSITIONING ANTENNA FOR WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PURPOSES. NO CHANGES TO THE EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ARE PLANNED WITH THE RENEWAL REQUEST. THE SUBJECT TOWER IS LOCATED AT 19900 CLARETTA AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 AND IS ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS) (APN 7056-006-800).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2005-1(2018) RENEWAL, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT SYNERGY DEVELOPMENT SERVICES, INC., ON BEHALF OF T-MOBILE WEST CORPORATION, TO RENEW A BUILDING-MOUNTED WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY. THE EXISTING WIRELESS FACILITY CONTAINS NINE (9) PANEL ANTENNAS, NINE (9) REMOTE RADIO UNITS, THREE (3) AMPLIFIERS, THREE (3) SUPPORT EQUIPMENT CABINETS, TWO (2) BATTERY CABINETS AND ONE (1) GLOBAL POSITIONING ANTENNA. THE SUBJECT WIRELESS FACILITY ANTENNAS ARE LOCATED INSIDE TWO (2) TOWER ELEMENTS OF A TWO-STORY COMMERCIAL BUILDING IN AN EXISTING COMMERCIAL SHOPPING DEVELOPMENT LOCATED AT 13237 SOUTH STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. NO CHANGES TO THE EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ARE PLANNED WITH THE RENEWAL REQUEST. THE SUBJECT SITE IS ZONED COMMUNITY COMMERCIAL (CC) (APN 7028-028-008).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.
